In-app Messages

In-app experiences that guide users to action

Build contextual modals, tooltips, banners, surveys, and embedded experiences across web and mobile, personalized by real-time data and powered by AI.

Get startedGet startedBook a demoBook a demo
  • 14-day free trial
  • No card required
  • Cancel anytime

The customer engagement platform trusted by 11,000+ brands

Our difference

Target audiences with real-time customer data and unlimited behavioral conditions.

Contextual experiences

Launch tooltips, banners, surveys, and embedded content exactly where users need guidance.

Real-time personalization

Use behavioral data, segments, and AI decisioning to dynamically tailor every experience.

Cross-channel orchestration

Increase engagement and conversions with coordinated messaging across every customer touchpoint.

Consistency across your ecosystem

Ensure campaigns, branding, and messaging stay aligned across every mobile and web experience.

“

Customer.io is the most intuitive and robust omnichannel messaging platform I’ve ever used. They beat the competition out of the water.

Alex MacCaw
Founder / Clearbit

Higher engagement rates

3.2x
Klar

Increase in referrals

200%
Monarch

Lugg

Multi-channel strategy conversion

Everything you need
to build smarter customer engagement

Get startedGet startedBook a demoBook a demo
Key features

Build in-app experiences that feel
native to your product

Embedded experiences

Personalize your product without shipping code

Embed dynamic content directly inside your product experience.

  • Display personalized recommendations
  • Update onboarding flows instantly
  • Deliver contextual experiences across web and mobile
Tooltips and onboarding

Drive users to value sooner

Drive feature adoption with contextual onboarding experiences.

  • Anchor tooltips to UI elements
  • Educate users without interrupting workflows
  • Trigger onboarding based on user behavior
AI-powered optimization

Create better in-app messages with AI

Use AI to build, personalize, and optimize customer experiences.

  • Draft messages and variants with AI
  • Tailor content to each user in real time
  • Surface the best-performing version automatically
Notification inbox

Keep important messages visible, organized, and personalized

Centralize every update in one customizable inbox, with real-time segments keeping notifications relevant and on-brand.

  • Surface high-priority updates first
  • Deliver personalized inbox experiences to every customer
  • Launch without building custom infrastructure

2.5%

lift in monthly revenue

12-15%

consistent conversion rate

“

Messaging frequency is key for our strategy. We can’t email our customers daily, so increasing frequency with a multi-channel strategy is how we can scale message volume. The conversion rates prove that strategy is working.

Ugo Iwuchukwu
Head of Marketing & Partnerships / Bamboo
Read case study

Additional features

  • Modals

    Static in-app pop-ups with screen overlay.

  • Banners

    Rectangular message displays on the top or bottom of screen.

  • Surveys

    Collect onboarding feedback, NPS, CSAT, and customer insights in-app.

  • Tooltips

    Guide onboarding and feature adoption with contextual UI prompts.

  • Carousel

    Content users can swipe without dismissing your message.

  • Templates

    Create messages from pre-built templates or start from scratch.

  • Dynamic content

    Use Liquid and AI to personalize your messages.

  • A/B testing

    Optimize messages and monitor performance.

  • Metrics

    Monitor message performance with sends, opens, clicks, and fails.

  • Live preview

    Preview experiences directly on your website before publishing.

  • Multi-language

    Store language preferences for message localization.

  • Priority

    Choose the order of messages sent to a person.

Developers

Tools built for modern teams

Deliver polished in-app experiences with lightweight SDKs, flexible APIs, and developer-friendly tooling.

  • Mobile SDKs

    Purpose-built SDKs for iOS, Android,
    and web applications.

  • APIs

    Move data in and out of Customer.io from your terminal,
    Postman, or custom integration.

  • CLI

    Install our skill, point an agent at it,
    and let it drive.

  • MCP server

    Create profiles, send, and check delivery from any
    MCP-compatible environment.

Questions?
We’ve got answers.

Guide users to action
